column1: # Advisory checks on a file right after an agent writes or edits it (plugins/core/scripts/edit-checks.sh,
# a PostToolUse hook on Write/Edit/MultiEdit). A hit is shown to the agent as context, never blocks.
# Tab-separated, one check per line; `-` for an empty field. Patterns are ERE, case-insensitive,
# run over the whole file. A check fires when the file's path matches one of `paths`, `must`
# matches, `also` (if set) matches, and `unless` (if set) doesn't.
# These are EXAMPLES that match the example traps in the data-traps skill and the api-contract
# skill: replace them with the mistakes your own team keeps making (one line each, with the fix).

column6: data-traps 1: analytics.payments_ledger has one row per (invoice, instalment); the amount owed is sum(instalment_amount) over all rows, never any() or argMax().
data-traps 2: line_total is the order-line total repeated on every shipment row; revenue is sum(line_total / shipment_count), not a plain sum.
data-traps 3: analytics.credit_notes is not deduplicated; aggregate to one row per credit note (or per day) before joining.
data-traps 5: invoices_daily mixes direct and marketplace invoices; filter channel = 'direct' on every leg of a receivables metric.
a view built on select * changes its columns whenever the source table does, and the routes and BI questions that read it break silently; list the columns.
api-contract (Errors): every error response has a stable `error` code the UI can act on, not only a free-text error_message; add the code and its row in the handoff doc.
